name: Digital OBD-II Scanner with Bluetooth
description: The digital OBD-II scanner connects to your smartphone via Bluetooth for real-time diagnostics. It reads and clears error codes, displays live sensor data, and offers a freeze-frame snapshot of engine conditions. Compatible with vehicles from 1996 onward.
shortDescription: Bluetooth OBD-II scanner for real-time diagnostics via smartphone.
